archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-08.5 Integrate Innovation into Production Environments
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Innovation only has impact if it reaches production. So, in this step, the new method or tool is embedded into the real statistical process. That can mean: - adding it to the standard GSBPM-based workflow, - making it available in the data platform / data fabric, - exposing it as a business or application service, - or adding it to the “official toolstack” of the organization.
Security, performance, and support requirements are added here. This step is often done together with IT, architecture, and process owners.
Value created: Innovation that is operational, supported, and available to real statistical production.
